notes: THE WORST CASE IN THE SET, and the most useful one. An iPhone screenshot of a PDF viewer ('Obrazac IP1 38.pdf') scrolled part-way down, so the ENTIRE identity header — sections I to VI, both parties, both OIBs, both IBANs, the period and all pay components — is above the visible area and simply absent from the image. Dark iOS chrome (19:00, battery 20%, a SmartThings back-link, close and share icons) frames the page, and the document is rendered as two separate page panels with a gap between them.

FOUR OF SEVEN CRITICAL FIELDS ARE UNREADABLE: employerName, employeeName, employeeOib all null, and only period survives. A correct extraction returns nulls and raises missing_critical_field for each. This sample exists to prove the product degrades honestly rather than inventing identity.

period is null BY DECISION (product owner, 2026-09-20). Section V is off-screen; the only date evidence is the RAZDOBLJE column of the naknade table (01.06.2025-30.06.2025). Inferring 2025-06 from that was judged over-reach: an extractor must not derive a value the document does not state. An engine returning 2025-06 here is now scored wrong.
doprinosiNaPlacu is genuinely 0.00 (section XIII.2 prints 0,00 with every sub-row blank), confirmed by XIV: 1755.00 + 200.00 + 0.00 = 1955.00.
Section XII's printed formula reads (IX.+X.+XI.) but obustave are subtracted: 1219.08 + 200.00 - 442.09 = 976.99. Do not implement the formula as printed.
Section 10 (UKUPNO POREZ I PRIREZ) has an empty value cell; the tax figure lives in VIII.6 (184.92). An extractor anchoring on the 'UKUPNO POREZ' label will read a blank.
